verdict.rationale: Gumloop workflows can include agent/LLM steps that use tools and data (docs-1, docs-34), with multi-model routing via chat completions covering Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, and OpenRouter (docs-12/28), plus tool use via Connectors and MCP servers (docs-25, docs-33/58) and human-in-the-loop approval for tool calls (docs-5/37). Missing for 10: explicit per-step model-selection UI documentation within the visual workflow builder and independent hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs.
